probe_stdout: CONFIRMED — FileNotFoundError propagated: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'git'. Spec requires None return for all failures, but only CalledProcessError is caught.
trigger_summary: When git is not found on PATH, subprocess.run raises FileNotFoundError which _get_head_commit does not catch (only catches CalledProcessError), causing the exception to propagate instead of returning None as the spec requires.
